suite: annotate rail suggestion (the row says so, select lights it, Accept, pick a different face)
expect_red: the pick action under a proposal arms the pick, the selected face's fill goes, and the same row now reads Cancel, pressed

mutations.contract: Arming takes the selected suggestion down first, so the arm captures and restores the scene as it really was.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_rail_row_with_a_proposal_says_so_and_accepts_it_in_place (2026-10-29). Without it the solid fill and the dimming are captured as the scene to put back.

mutations.contract: While a pick is armed the one pick action reads Cancel and is pressed.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff one_selection_one_hover_and_leaders_off (2026-11-10). Leaves the armed action row unpressed.
mutations.find: return { text: AA.ARMED_PICK_WORDS.cancel, title: AA.ARMED_PICK_WORDS.cancelTitle, pressed: true,
mutations.replace: return { text: AA.ARMED_PICK_WORDS.cancel, title: AA.ARMED_PICK_WORDS.cancelTitle, pressed: false,
